what_works: Designer portfolio leads with one centered name and one CTA ('Let's talk') — the entire hero is two elements and a vast field of white. Numbered project grid below feels organized without grid-lines or borders. Translates to a calm, premium contractor splash that scrolls into a project list.
what_does_not_translate: Loading-state intro animation isn't worth the perf cost on mobile — keep the centered hero composition, drop the intro choreography.
type_observations: Single contemporary sans family; hero name set at modest scale (not display-huge) — the restraint at hero size signals confidence more than a 200px headline would.
